entries.en: VLESS and REALITY Support in Surge Beta
entries.zh: Surge 测试版现已支持 VLESS 和 REALITY

entries.en: We have built a fully automated, AI-powered testing platform for Surge Engine. The platform continuously evaluates compatibility and performance against the latest official client implementations of all supported proxy protocols, helping ensure that Surge matches or exceeds their performance.
entries.zh: 我们为 Surge Engine 构建了一个完全自动化且由 AI 驱动的测试平台。该平台会持续评估 Surge Engine 在所有受支持的代理协议的最新官方客户端实现环境下的兼容性与性能，从而确保 Surge Engine 的性能能够与之匹配甚至超越。

entries.en: We have reservations about aspects of their technical design. At the same time, many of our users need these technologies, and we know some have turned to unofficial modified builds of Surge to access them, which carries real security risks. In the end, we decided that a supported, trustworthy implementation serves our users better than leaving them without one.
entries.zh: 我们对他们的技术设计的某些方面存有保留意见。同时，我们的许多用户需要这些技术，而且我们知道，有些用户已经转而使用 Surge 的非官方修改版本来获取这些技术，而这会带来切实的安全风险。最终，我们决定，提供一个受支持且值得信赖的实现方案，比让用户无此方案可用，更能服务于我们的用户。

entries.en: When a server closes the connection during setup, for example TrustTunnel with a wrong key, Surge now retries once and then fails, instead of retrying until the timeout.
entries.zh: 当服务器在设置期间关闭连接时（例如，TrustTunnel 的密钥错误），Surge 现在会重试一次然后失败，而不会一直重试直到超时。

entries.en: Why We're Adding VLESS and REALITY
entries.zh: 我们为何要添加 VLESS 和 REALITY

entries.en: WireGuard and Tailscale: changing [Proxy] or [Proxy Group] no longer restarts every WireGuard and Tailscale session. A session is kept when its policy line and its own section are unchanged, so connections through it keep working. Before, a change made over the tailnet, such as from surge-cli or MCP on another device, cut off its own reply.
entries.zh: WireGuard 和 Tailscale：更改 [Proxy] 或 [Proxy Group] 后，将不再重启每个 WireGuard 和 Tailscale 会话。如果某个会话的策略行及其自身部分均未更改，则该会话将得以保留，从而确保通过它的连接仍能正常工作。此前，通过 tailnet 进行的更改（例如来自另一台设备上的 surge-cli 或 MCP 的更改）会中断其自身的响应。

entries.en: Wrong credentials now fail right away instead of after the 10-second setup timeout. This covers:
entries.zh: 现在，错误的凭据会立即失败，而不会等到 10 秒的设置超时之后。这包括：

entries.en: You can now mark a policy as avoided. Use this when a policy passes latency tests but performs poorly in practice, for example with low bandwidth. Automatic groups (url-test, fallback, load-balance and smart) skip an avoided policy as long as any other member is usable. If nothing else is left, the avoided policy is still used.
entries.zh: 现在，您可以将某项策略标记为“已避免”。当某项策略通过了延迟测试但在实际使用中表现不佳（例如带宽较低）时，可使用此功能。只要其他成员可用，自动策略组（url-test、fallback、load-balance 和 smart）就会跳过“已避免”的策略。如果别无选择，系统仍会使用“已避免”的策略。

entries.en: advertise-exit-node = true: offer this device as an exit node. Other tailnet devices that select it send all their internet traffic through Surge's rules.
entries.zh: advertise-exit-node = true：将此设备提供为出口节点。选择该设备的其他 tailnet 设备会将其所有互联网流量通过 Surge 的规则发送。

entries.en: advertise-routes = [192.168.1.0/24](http://192.168.1.0/24), ...: offer this device as a subnet router for the listed networks.
entries.zh: advertise-routes = [192.168.1.0/24](http://192.168.1.0/24), ...: 将此设备作为所列网络的子网路由器提供。

entries.en: allow-peer-access = true: other devices on your tailnet can connect to this device through its tailnet address. For example, they can use Surge's HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy or other services running on this device. (The old parameter accept-incoming has been renamed, but it will still be read for compatibility.)
entries.zh: allow-peer-access = true：您 tailnet 网络中的其他设备可以通过该设备的 tailnet 地址连接到此设备。例如，它们可以使用 Surge 的 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理或运行在此设备上的其他服务。（旧参数 accept-incoming 已被重命名，但为了兼容仍会读取。）

entries.en: allow-peer-access = true: the peer side can open connections to this device through an existing tunnel.
entries.zh: allow-peer-access = true：对端可以通过现有隧道与此设备建立连接。

entries.en: an SSH host key that does not match `server-fingerprint` (the error names the key the server offered)
entries.zh: 不匹配 `server-fingerprint` 的 SSH 主机密钥（错误信息中会指明服务器提供的密钥名称）

entries.en: block-quic=auto now uses adaptive mode for every policy except DIRECT, so QUIC-only apps keep working through proxies. Policies that cannot relay UDP still block QUIC.
entries.zh: block-quic=auto 现在对除 DIRECT 外的所有策略都使用自适应模式，因此仅使用 QUIC 的应用仍可正常通过代理工作。无法转发 UDP 的策略仍会阻止 QUIC。

entries.en: listen-port = 51820: Surge acts as a WireGuard server that phones, laptops, and other clients can connect to. A peer can leave out endpoint; Surge learns the client's address when it connects and keeps up when the address changes.
entries.zh: listen-port = 51820：Surge 充当 WireGuard 服务器，手机、笔记本电脑和其他客户端都可以连接到该服务器。对等端可以省略端点；Surge 会在客户端连接时获知其地址，并在地址变更时保持同步。

entries.en: socks5-listen now supports username:password@ authentication, the same way as http-listen.
entries.zh: socks5-listen 现在支持与 http-listen 相同的 username:password@ 身份验证方式。

entries.en: surge-cli module list now shows details for each module: its type, version, file modification time, and the number of lines it adds to each section (or why it failed to load). New surge-cli module show <name> also shows every #! header field, the declared argument names and the module text. Also available through MCP (list_modules and the new get_module) and the HTTP API (GET /v1/modules and the new /v1/modules/detail).
entries.zh: surge-cli module list 现在会显示每个模块的详细信息：其类型、版本、文件修改时间，以及它为每个部分添加的行数（或显示其加载失败的原因）。新的 surge-cli module show <name> 命令还会显示每个 #! 标头字段、声明的参数名称以及模块文本。该功能也通过 MCP（list_modules 和新的 get_module）以及 HTTP API（GET /v1/modules 和新的 /v1/modules/detail）提供。

entries.en: surge-cli rule match and rule explain now show where the matched rule comes from: the profile file and line, or the module that added it. For a RULE-SET or DOMAIN-SET, they also show the entry inside the set that matched. The same fields are returned through MCP and the HTTP API.
entries.zh: surge-cli 的规则匹配和规则解释功能现在会显示匹配的规则来自何处：配置文件及其行号，或添加该规则的模块。对于 RULE-SET 或 DOMAIN-SET，它们还会显示规则集内部匹配的具体条目。相同的字段也会通过 MCP 和 HTTP API 返回。

entries.en: GET /v1/policies of the HTTP API now accepts the include_external=true query parameter. The response then contains an additional external-policies field that lists the policies loaded from external policy groups (policy-path). Each entry includes the policy name, the group it belongs to, and an identifier. Pass the identifier as the policy option of $httpClient to send a request through that policy, since external policies cannot be referenced by name.
entries.zh: HTTP API 的 GET /v1/policies 现在接受 include_external=true 查询参数。响应将包含一个额外的 external-policies 字段，其中列出了从外部策略组（policy-path）加载的策略。每个条目都包含策略名称、所属策略组以及一个标识符。由于无法通过名称引用外部策略，因此请将此标识符作为 $httpClient 的策略选项传递，以便通过该策略发送请求。

entries.en: surge-cli capture-session list | dump <session> | data <session> <key> <request|response>
entries.zh: surge-cli capture-session list | dump <session> | data <session> <key> <request|response>

entries.en: Downloads over QUIC on lossy networks use less memory.
entries.zh: 在易丢包网络上通过 QUIC 进行下载时，内存使用更少。

entries.en: Envoy reset the connection during fast UDP downloads.
entries.zh: Envoy 在快速 UDP 下载期间重置了连接。

entries.en: Fast UDP uploads lost most of their packets.
entries.zh: 快速 UDP 上传丢失了大部分数据包。

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/2 CONNECT losing the end of an upload when the server finished first.
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器先完成时，HTTP/2 CONNECT 会丢失上传末尾数据的问题。

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/2 CONNECT-UDP:
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP/2 CONNECT-UDP：

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/3 uploads (TrustTunnel with `h3=true`) stalling for several seconds when many connections were busy.
entries.zh: 修复了在使用 TrustTunnel 和 `h3=true` 时，当大量连接繁忙导致 HTTP/3 上传暂停数秒的问题。

entries.en: Fixed Hysteria 2 uploads with obfuscation stalling for good a few seconds in.
entries.zh: 修复了 Hysteria 2 在启用混淆后上传几秒即卡住的问题。

entries.en: Fixed MITM of HTTP/2 for many hosts pushing the Network Extension past its memory limit. This was a regression in recent betas.
entries.zh: 修复了针对许多主机的 HTTP/2 MITM 问题，该问题导致网络扩展超出其内存限制。这是近期测试版中出现的一项回归问题。

entries.en: Fixed TLS-based policies dropping the rest of an upload once the server had finished sending.
entries.zh: 修复了基于 TLS 的策略在服务器完成发送后丢弃上传剩余部分的问题。

entries.en: Fixed Trojan UDP to hostnames failing with sing-box servers.
entries.zh: Fixed Trojan UDP to hostnames failing with sing-box servers.

entries.en: Fixed TrustTunnel HTTP/2 downloads always breaking after a few seconds at full speed.
entries.zh: 修复了 TrustTunnel 的 HTTP/2 下载在全速运行几秒后总会中断的问题。

entries.en: Fixed UDP datagrams over Hysteria 2, TUIC and MASQUE being dropped while a large upload ran on the same connection.
entries.zh: 修复了在相同连接上进行大文件上传时，通过 Hysteria 2、TUIC 和 MASQUE 传输的 UDP 数据报被丢弃的问题。

entries.en: Fixed Vector cutting the upload short when the server finished first.
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器先完成时 Vector 截断上传的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a crash when an HTTP API request had a field of the wrong type, such as a non-numeric `timeout` for `/v1/scripting/evaluate`. Such requests now get a 400 response.
entries.zh: 修复了当 HTTP API 请求中包含错误类型的字段（例如，`/v1/scripting/evaluate` 的 `timeout` 不是数值）时发生的崩溃问题。现在，此类请求将返回 400 响应。

entries.en: Fixed a crash with VLESS Vision.
entries.zh: 修复了 VLESS Vision 的一个崩溃问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Snell server, MTProto proxy and port forwarding failing to restart after a profile reload with "Address already in use". This was a regression.
entries.zh: 修复了在重新加载配置文件后，Snell 服务器、MTProto 代理和端口转发因“地址已被使用”而未能重启的问题。这是一个回归问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Snell v6 server dropping IPv6 UDP.
entries.zh: 修复了 Snell v6 服务器丢弃 IPv6 UDP 的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Vector server resetting the UDP stream for datagrams to other hostnames.
entries.zh: 修复了 Vector 服务器将 UDP 数据报流重置到其他主机名的问题。

entries.en: HTTP/3 tunnels (TrustTunnel with `h3=true`, MASQUE) and SSH no longer spend CPU formatting log lines for every packet.
entries.zh: HTTP/3 隧道（TrustTunnel 与 `h3=true`、MASQUE）和 SSH 不再为每个数据包花费 CPU 时间来格式化日志行。

entries.en: Hysteria 2 and TUIC downloads are faster and use less CPU. Surge now acknowledges received packets in batches. On a 10 GbE test machine, Hysteria 2 went from 2.86 to 3.84 Gbps, with CPU dropping from 137% to 108%.
entries.zh: Hysteria 2 和 TUIC 的下载速度更快，占用的 CPU 更少。Surge 现在可以批量确认已接收的数据包。在一台 10 GbE 测试机上，Hysteria 2 的速率从 2.86 提升至 3.84 Gbps，CPU 占用率从 137% 降至 108%。

entries.en: Hysteria 2 and TUIC uploads no longer send the whole congestion window in one burst, which overran the server and caused packet loss. Several uploads sharing one connection now get a fair share.
entries.zh: Hysteria 2 和 TUIC 上传功能不再一次性发送整个拥塞窗口，这曾导致服务器过载并引发丢包。现在，共享同一连接的多个上传任务可以公平地分配带宽。

entries.en: MASQUE UDP associations now survive their QUIC connection being closed by the server.
entries.zh: MASQUE UDP 关联现在可以在服务器关闭其 QUIC 连接后仍然存在。

entries.en: MASQUE now falls back to 1,200-byte packets for 30 minutes when a connection that started at 1,350 bytes gets no reply. Paths with a smaller MTU can connect again. MASQUE also accepts larger DATAGRAM frames from the server.
entries.zh: 当一条以 1,350 字节发起的连接未收到任何响应时，MASQUE 现在会在 30 分钟内回退到 1,200 字节的数据包。MTU 较小的路径可以重新建立连接。MASQUE 现在也接受来自服务器的更大数据报帧。

entries.en: Opening many tunnels at once through MASQUE, TUIC, HTTP/2 CONNECT, TrustTunnel or VLESS gRPC no longer leaves some of them stalled or hanging. Surge now opens more connections when the server's stream limit is reached.
entries.zh: 通过 MASQUE、TUIC、HTTP/2 CONNECT、TrustTunnel 或 VLESS gRPC 同时打开多个隧道时，不会再出现部分隧道停滞或挂起的情况。当达到服务器的流限制时，Surge 现在会打开更多连接。

entries.en: Outgoing UDP sockets and the SOCKS5 UDP relay now use larger socket buffers instead of the system default, so fewer datagrams are dropped under load.
entries.zh: 出站 UDP 套接字和 SOCKS5 UDP 中继现在使用更大的套接字缓冲区，而非系统默认值，因此在负载下丢包会更少。

entries.en: QUIC sessions carried over another proxy's UDP relay, such as Hysteria 2 over SOCKS5 or Shadowsocks, now send packets in batches. Their uploads are much faster.
entries.zh: 通过其他代理的 UDP 中继运行的 QUIC 会话（例如通过 SOCKS5 或 Shadowsocks 运行的 Hysteria 2）现在会批量发送数据包。其上传速度大幅提升。

entries.en: QUIC uploads (Hysteria 2, TUIC) on lossy, high-latency networks are much faster.
entries.zh: 在丢包、高延迟的网络上，QUIC 上传（Hysteria 2、TUIC）的速度要快得多。

entries.en: Reliability
entries.zh: 可靠性

entries.en: Snell server and Vector:
entries.zh: Snell 服务器和 Vector：

entries.en: The proxy editor now supports VLESS, including REALITY, gRPC and WebSocket, and can import `vless://` share links.
entries.zh: 代理编辑器现在支持 VLESS，包括 REALITY、gRPC 和 WebSocket，并且可以导入 `vless://` 分享链接。

entries.en: The proxy editor now supports VLESS, including REALITY, gRPC and WebSocket. You can also import `vless://` share links.
entries.zh: 代理编辑器现在支持 VLESS，包括 REALITY、gRPC 和 WebSocket。您还可以导入 `vless://` 分享链接。

entries.en: UDP over AnyTLS and VLESS no longer loses most of its upload at high rates. Queued TLS writes are now sent together.
entries.zh: UDP over AnyTLS 和 VLESS 在高速率下已不再丢失大部分上传数据。现在，已排队的 TLS 写入将一并发送。

entries.en: UDP sent faster than the connection could carry piled up and delayed later datagrams by seconds.
entries.zh: UDP 发送速度超过了连接承载能力，导致后续数据报被堆积并延迟了数秒。

entries.en: VMess, TUIC v4 and all Shadowsocks ciphers are back in the proxy editor. TUIC v4 is a version option of TUIC.
entries.zh: VMess、TUIC v4 和所有 Shadowsocks 密码已重新加入代理编辑器。TUIC v4 是 TUIC 的一个版本选项。

entries.en: When a Hysteria 2, TUIC or MASQUE server stops answering, Surge now notices within about 3 seconds and opens a new connection. Before, new requests kept going to the dead connection, and downloads hung until the idle timeout.
entries.zh: 当 Hysteria 2、TUIC 或 MASQUE 服务器停止响应时，Surge 现在大约能在 3 秒内察觉到并建立新连接。在此之前，新请求会持续发送到已失效的连接上，导致下载任务在空闲超时前一直处于挂起状态。

entries.en: Added VLESS Encryption (mlkem768x25519plus), including share-link import and proxy editor controls.
entries.zh: 新增 VLESS 加密（mlkem768x25519plus），包括分享链接导入和代理编辑器控件。

entries.en: Added VLESS XHTTP transport with stream-one, stream-up and packet-up modes over HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 or HTTP/3, including VLESS Encryption and Vision.
entries.zh: 新增支持通过 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 或 HTTP/3 的 VLESS XHTTP 传输，包含 stream-one、stream-up 和 packet-up 模式，并支持 VLESS 加密和 Vision。

entries.en: Fixed Always use CONNECT not being saved for HTTPS policies, and corrected when TLS and Block QUIC settings appear.
entries.zh: 修复了“始终使用 CONNECT”未针对 HTTPS 策略组保存的问题，并更正了 TLS 和“阻止 QUIC”设置出现的时间。

entries.en: Fixed Tailscale connections staying on a relay after a peer restarted because updated peer information was not applied.
entries.zh: 修复了在对等方重启后，由于未应用更新后的对等方信息，导致 Tailscale 连接仍停留在中继上的问题。

entries.en: Fixed WebSocket policies failing to connect when their ALPN list included h2 and the server selected it.
entries.zh: 修复了当策略组的 ALPN 列表包含 h2 且服务器选择该协议时，WebSocket 策略组无法连接的问题。

entries.en: Fixed established VLESS gRPC, HTTP/2 CONNECT and TrustTunnel connections being incorrectly counted as connection setup failures when they ended with an error.
entries.zh: 修复了当已建立的 VLESS gRPC、HTTP/2 CONNECT 和 TrustTunnel 连接以错误结束时，被错误地计为连接建立失败的问题。

entries.en: Improved QUIC upload performance and reduced CPU usage when chained through a proxy's UDP relay.
entries.zh: 改进了通过代理的 UDP 中继进行链式传输时的 QUIC 上传性能，并降低了 CPU 使用率。

entries.en: Reduced memory retained after QUIC downloads on lossy networks.
entries.zh: 降低了在丢包网络上通过 QUIC 下载后保留的内存。

entries.en: Reorganized the proxy editor with a remembered Show Advanced Settings option and controls for more protocol, TLS, WireGuard and Tailscale settings.
entries.zh: 重新组织了代理编辑器，增加了可记忆的高级设置显示选项，并加入了更多协议、TLS、WireGuard 和 Tailscale 设置的控件。

entries.en: Reorganized the proxy editor with an Advanced page that indicates settings in use, and added controls for more protocol, TLS, WireGuard, Tailscale and testing settings.
entries.zh: 重新组织了代理编辑器，新增了一个“高级”页面用于显示当前正在使用的设置，并为更多协议、TLS、WireGuard、Tailscale 和测试设置添加了控件。

entries.en: The proxy editor now imports share links for all supported proxy protocols, as well as proxy lines copied from Surge profiles; unsupported settings are reported instead of silently omitted.
entries.zh: 现在，代理编辑器会导入所有受支持的代理协议的共享链接，以及从 Surge 配置文件中复制的代理行；对于不受支持的设置，系统会报告错误，而不会静默忽略。

entries.en: Updated list layouts and badges, and added member counts for policy groups in the proxy list.
entries.zh: 更新了列表布局和徽章，并在代理列表中添加了策略组的成员数量。

entries.en: Badges are slightly larger, and rows in badge lists are more compact.
entries.zh: 徽章尺寸略大，徽章列表中的行间距更紧凑。

entries.en: DNS queries are now resent after 1, 2 and 4 seconds, and a lookup that gets no answer fails after 5 seconds instead of about 11.
entries.zh: DNS 查询现在会在 1、2 和 4 秒后重新发送，而没有任何响应的查找会在 5 秒后失败，而不是大约 11 秒后。

entries.en: Encrypted DNS now follows `dns-follow-interface`. With Wi-Fi Assist or hybrid, encrypted DNS is also queried over cellular.
entries.zh: 加密 DNS 现在遵循 `dns-follow-interface`。在使用 Wi-Fi 辅助或混合模式时，加密 DNS 也会通过蜂窝网络进行查询。

entries.en: Fixed DNS-over-TLS queries waiting for the timeout when the server closed the connection.
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器关闭连接时，DNS-over-TLS 查询等待超时的错误。

entries.en: Fixed a failing encrypted DNS server marking the network as Unstable and pausing smart group learning while the network itself was fine.
entries.zh: 修复了一个问题：有问题的加密 DNS 服务器会将网络标记为“不稳定”，并暂停智能策略组学习，而网络本身并无异常。

entries.en: Fixed devices that use Surge as a Tailscale exit node being unable to resolve any domain.
entries.zh: 修复了将 Surge 用作 Tailscale 出口节点的设备无法解析任何域的问题。

entries.en: Fixed smart groups not failing over when an IPv6-only proxy server became unreachable, for example after moving to an IPv4-only network.
entries.zh: 修复了当仅支持 IPv6 的代理服务器不可用时（例如，在切换到仅支持 IPv4 的网络后），智能组未能进行故障转移的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Wi-Fi Assist and hybrid cellular backup connecting over the primary network for chained proxies. Smart group members with `hybrid=false` or a bound interface no longer get a cellular backup.
entries.zh: 修复了 Wi-Fi 辅助功能和混合蜂窝备份在链式代理下通过主网络连接的问题。包含 `hybrid=false` 或已绑定接口的策略组成员将不再获得蜂窝备份。

entries.en: Fixed the folded policy group cards showing through the corners of an expanded card.
entries.zh: 修复了折叠的策略组卡片会从展开卡片的角落透出的问题。

entries.en: Greatly reduced memory use with thousands of proxies.
entries.zh: 在使用数千个代理时，内存使用量大幅减少。

entries.en: Hysteria 2, TUIC and MASQUE now detect a server that stopped answering after 3 seconds, instead of almost 4.
entries.zh: Hysteria 2、TUIC 和 MASQUE 现在会在服务器停止响应 3 秒后（而非近 4 秒后）将其检测为不可用。

entries.en: New `ws-http-upgrade=true` option (with `ws=true`) uses the HTTPUpgrade transport for VMess, Trojan and VLESS. Share links with type=httpupgrade are imported, and the proxy editor has an HTTPUpgrade switch.
entries.zh: 新的 `ws-http-upgrade=true` 选项（与 `ws=true` 一起）为 VMess、Trojan 和 VLESS 使用 HTTPUpgrade 传输方式。使用 type=httpupgrade 的分享链接会被导入，并且代理编辑器中新增了一个 HTTPUpgrade 开关。

entries.en: Tailscale now sends its traffic through the interface of a bound DIRECT underlying policy, such as CELLULAR-ONLY, or through its own `interface`.
entries.zh: Tailscale 现在会通过已绑定的 DIRECT 底层策略（例如 CELLULAR-ONLY）的接口，或通过其自身的 `interface` 发送流量。

entries.en: The Dashboard request list uses much less CPU and pauses while hidden.
entries.zh: 仪表板请求列表的 CPU 占用率大幅降低，并在隐藏时暂停。

entries.en: The Surge tvOS deployment page now offers any combination of Ponte channels: one IPv4 channel, IPv6 direct access and proxy relay, as on Mac. Older Surge tvOS versions keep working. This update will not take effect until subsequent tvOS versions are also updated to 6.0.0.
entries.zh: Surge tvOS 部署页面现在支持任意组合的 Ponte 通道：一个 IPv4 通道、IPv6 直接访问和代理中继，与 Mac 版相同。旧版 Surge tvOS 仍可继续使用。此更新在后续的 tvOS 版本也更新到 6.0.0 之前不会生效。

entries.en: The packet capture list is laid out like the request list, and packet times are now shown correctly in 12-hour regions.
entries.zh: 数据包捕获列表的布局与请求列表类似，现在数据包时间可在 12 小时时区中正确显示。

entries.en: The request list now names each request's status next to its colored dot, with neutral type badges and gray placeholders for sites without an icon.
entries.zh: 现在，请求列表会在每个请求的彩色圆点旁边标明其状态，对于没有图标的网站，则使用中性类型的徽章和灰色占位符。

entries.en: Top Traffic bars on the dashboard now show the proxy share in blue and the direct share in purple.
entries.zh: 仪表盘上的“Top Traffic”条形图现在以蓝色显示代理流量占比，以紫色显示直接流量占比。

entries.en: VLESS REALITY now sends the same TLS ClientHello as Chrome.
entries.zh: VLESS REALITY 现在发送的 TLS ClientHello 与 Chrome 相同。

entries.en: A `policy-path` that points to a complete profile now reads only its `[Proxy]` section, greatly lowering peak memory use.
entries.zh: 一个指向完整配置文件的 `policy-path` 现在仅读取其 `[Proxy]` 部分，从而大幅降低了峰值内存使用。

entries.en: Additionally, we have completed comprehensive real-world benchmarks comparing every supported proxy protocol against its official client. Across both throughput and latency, Surge matches or exceeds official client performance—fully aligning with the theoretical design of each protocol.
entries.zh: 此外，我们已完成全面的真实世界基准测试，将每个受支持的代理协议与其官方客户端进行了对比。在吞吐量和延迟方面，Surge 的性能均与官方客户端持平或更优，完全符合各协议的理论设计。

entries.en: Fixed XHTTP connections behind a CDN that resets finished streams being counted as policy errors.
entries.zh: 修复了 CDN 后方的 XHTTP 连接中，已完成的流被重置后计为策略组错误的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a folded HTTP header line losing its continuation.
entries.zh: 修复了折叠的 HTTP 标头行丢失其续行内容的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a moving list on the Profile and Modules pages not following the finger.
entries.zh: 修复了“配置文件”和“模块”页面上的移动列表未跟随手指移动的问题。

entries.en: Fixed cards in the row below an expanded policy group card fading out.
entries.zh: 修复了展开的策略组卡片下方行中的卡片会淡出的问题。

entries.en: Fixed policy group warnings from the previous profile staying after a reload.
entries.zh: 修复了重新加载后仍保留先前配置文件的策略组警告的问题。

entries.en: Fixed response trailers being lost with HTTP/2 clients or when a script buffered the body, which broke gRPC calls.
entries.zh: 修复了在 HTTP/2 客户端环境下，或当脚本对有效负载进行缓冲时，响应尾部数据丢失的问题，该问题曾导致 gRPC 调用中断。

entries.en: Fixed the issue where manual restart might be required for configuration synchronization to be correctly applied.
entries.zh: 修复了可能需要手动重启才能正确应用配置同步的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the last lines of the script editor being hidden behind the keyboard on iPhone.
entries.zh: 修复了在 iPhone 上脚本编辑器最后几行被键盘隐藏的问题。

entries.en: Greatly reduced memory use with large profiles, many inline rules, large modules and thousands of tested policies.
entries.zh: 大幅降低了大型配置文件、大量内联规则、大型模块以及数千个已测试策略组的内存使用。

entries.en: Much faster TCP between apps and the tunnel: in loopback tests, download nearly doubled and upload more than doubled.
entries.zh: 应用与隧道之间的 TCP 速度大幅提升：在回环测试中，下载速度几乎翻倍，上传速度则增长了一倍多。

entries.en: Much higher throughput and lower CPU use for local apps in Enhanced Mode, and faster uploads from gateway devices over high-latency links.
entries.zh: 增强模式下本地应用的吞吐量更高、CPU 使用率更低，通过高延迟链路从网关设备上传的速度更快。

entries.en: New `restart-ponte-server` command in surge-cli, also available in the HTTP API and as an MCP tool.
entries.zh: surge-cli 中新增 `restart-ponte-server` 命令，该命令也已在 HTTP API 和 MCP 工具中提供。

entries.en: Optimized profile and log viewing.
entries.zh: 优化了配置文件和日志的查看功能。

entries.en: Redesigned Surge tvOS start screen, with new profile and log viewers.
entries.zh: 重新设计了 Surge tvOS 启动屏幕，并新增了配置文件和日志查看器。

entries.en: Redesigned the UI interface with the new Surge iOS 6.0 style.
entries.zh: 采用全新的 Surge iOS 6.0 风格重新设计了用户界面。

entries.en: Reference results (latest build):
entries.zh: 参考结果（最新构建）：

entries.en: Request details now show a Response Trailers section.
entries.zh: 请求详情现在会显示“响应附加标头”部分。

entries.en: Surge Ponte now allows configuring multiple channels like the Mac version.
entries.zh: Surge Ponte 现在支持配置多个通道，与 Mac 版本功能一致。

entries.en: Surge iOS Beta: VIF Loopback Benchmark & Protocol Performance Validation
entries.zh: Surge iOS 测试版：VIF 回环基准测试与协议性能验证

entries.en: Surge now warns when a profile has more than 5000 inline rules, or when `include-all-networks` is combined with `suspend=true`.
entries.zh: Surge 现在会在一个配置文件包含超过 5000 条内联规则时，或在 `include-all-networks` 与 `suspend=true` 结合使用时发出警告。

entries.en: Synchronized with the Surge iOS 6.0 engine, supporting all new features.
entries.zh: 与 Surge iOS 6.0 引擎同步，支持所有新功能。

entries.en: The Dashboard request details now show a response's trailer section.
entries.zh: 仪表板请求详情现在会显示响应标尾部分。

entries.en: The Loopback test on the iPerf page is now available.
entries.zh: iPerf 页面上的回环测试现已可用。

entries.en: The latest Surge iOS beta introduces a one-tap VIF Loopback test to the iPerf page. This tool measures the throughput of both the virtual interface (VIF) and the userspace TCP stack, allowing you to easily verify their performance on your device.
entries.zh: 最新的 Surge iOS 测试版在 iPerf 页面中引入了一项一键 VIF 环回测试。该工具可测量虚拟接口 (VIF) 和用户空间 TCP 栈的吞吐量，让您能够轻松验证其在设备上的性能。

entries.en: The script editor opened from Utilities now stays inside the tab, and saving lists the edited file first.
entries.zh: 现在，通过“实用工具”打开的脚本编辑器会保留在选项卡内，保存时会首先列出已编辑的文件。

entries.en: URL patterns that start with a host are now skipped for requests to other hosts, making HTTP requests faster and saving memory with large modules.
entries.zh: 现在，以主机开头的 URL 模式在针对其他主机的请求中将被跳过，从而加快 HTTP 请求速度，并在使用大型模块时节省内存。

entries.en: VLESS REALITY now works with servers older than Xray 25.5.16.
entries.zh: VLESS REALITY 现在可与早于 Xray 的服务器配合使用 25.5.16。

entries.en: iPhone 17 Pro series (single connection): 18.7 Gbps downlink / 12.7 Gbps uplink
entries.zh: iPhone 17 Pro 系列（单连接）：18.7 Gbps 下行链路 / 12.7 Gbps 上行链路

entries.en: Edited local rule sets, domain sets and `policy-path` files now take effect on a profile reload, and failed local resources are retried on every reload.
entries.zh: 编辑后的本地规则集、域名集和 `policy-path` 文件现在会在重新加载配置文件时生效，并且每次重新加载时都会重试失败的本地资源。

entries.en: Fix the issue where the logs and profile pages cannot scroll
entries.zh: 修复日志和配置文件页面无法滚动的问题

entries.en: Fixed DIRECT showing up as a member of a `policy-path` group when the subscription lists "DIRECT = direct" in `[Proxy]`.
entries.zh: 修复了当订阅在 `[Proxy]` 中列出 "DIRECT = direct" 时，DIRECT 错误地显示为 `policy-path` 策略组成员的问题。

entries.en: Fixed Tailscale and WireGuard peers failing DNS queries over TCP to Surge's session address, which made Tailscale clients report unstable DNS.
entries.zh: 修复了 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 对等节点无法通过 TCP 向 Surge 的会话地址发起 DNS 查询的问题，该问题曾导致 Tailscale 客户端报告 DNS 不稳定。

entries.en: Fixed a profile or included file that did not actually change being reported as changed or reloaded.
entries.zh: 修复了未实际更改的配置文件或包含文件被报告为已更改或已重新加载的问题。

entries.en: Fixed an import error alert disappearing with the open panel and leaving the main window dimmed.
entries.zh: 修复了导入错误警报在打开面板后消失，并导致主窗口保持灰显的问题。

entries.en: Fixed downloading a profile that uses `#!include` with a URL failing with "Linked profile not ready".
entries.zh: 修复了下载使用 `#!include` 的配置文件时，因“关联的配置文件尚未就绪”而失败的问题。

entries.en: Fixed importing a profile that uses `#!include` with a URL failing with "Linked profile not ready".
entries.zh: 修复了使用 `#!include` 的配置文件通过 URL 导入时，因“关联的配置文件尚未就绪”而失败的问题。

entries.en: Fixed one XHTTP failure showing twice in a policy's recent errors.
entries.zh: 修复了某项 XHTTP 失败在策略组的近期错误中重复显示的问题。

entries.en: Fixed policy group cards showing around the corners of an expanded card.
entries.zh: 修复了策略组卡片在展开卡片周围显示的问题。

entries.en: Fixed single-stream uploads from local apps stalling for seconds at multi-gigabit speeds on fast iPads such as iPad Pro M5.
entries.zh: Fixed single-stream uploads from local apps stalling for seconds at multi-gigabit speeds on fast iPads such as iPad Pro M5.

entries.en: Fixed text in badge list rows touching the row edges before iOS 26.
entries.zh: 修复了在 iOS 26 之前，徽章列表行中的文本与行边缘接触的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Include All Networks warning about `suspend=true` counting disabled or commented-out subnet settings.
entries.zh: 修复了“Include All Networks”警告中关于 `suspend=true` 会统计已禁用或已注释的子网设置的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the activity bar labeling the warning count as errors.
entries.zh: 修复了活动栏将警告数量标记为错误的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the add-rule panel offering no rule types when Surge could not read the browser's current URL.
entries.zh: 修复了在 Surge 无法读取浏览器当前 URL 时，add-rule 面板未提供任何规则类型的问题。

entries.en: Long-pressing the request detail header now shows a Copy bubble over the URL.
entries.zh: 现在，长按请求详情标题后，会在 URL 上方显示一个“复制”气泡。

entries.en: New request status colors in the Dashboard: Failed is red, Rejected gray, Modified orange and Establishing cyan.
entries.zh: 仪表盘中新增了请求状态颜色：失败为红色，已拒绝为灰色，已修改为橙色，建立中为青色。

entries.en: New request status colors: Failed is red, Rejected gray, Modified orange and Establishing cyan.
entries.zh: 新的请求状态颜色：失败为红色，拒绝为灰色，修改为橙色，建立中为青色。

entries.en: Redesigned the DNS cache list and details, with remaining cache lifetimes, case-insensitive search and tap-to-copy.
entries.zh: 重新设计了 DNS 缓存列表和详细信息，新增了缓存剩余存活时间、不区分大小写的搜索功能以及轻点复制功能。

entries.en: Reworked the remote page with a large title, round switch buttons and an icon grid of tools.
entries.zh: 重做了远程页面，采用了大号标题、圆形切换按钮以及工具图标网格。

entries.en: Starting Surge now removes deleted or unparseable modules from the enabled list.
entries.zh: 现在启动 Surge 时，会从已启用列表中移除已删除或无法解析的模块。

entries.en: Surge iOS Beta: VIF Loopback Benchmark & Protocol Performance Validation The latest Surge iOS beta introduces a one-tap VIF Loopback test to the iPerf page. This tool measures the throughput of both the virtual interface (VIF) and the userspace TCP stack…
entries.zh: Surge iOS 测试版：VIF 回环基准测试与协议性能验证 最新的 Surge iOS 测试版在 iPerf 页面中引入了一项一键式 VIF 回环测试。该工具可测量虚拟接口 (VIF) 和用户空间 TCP 栈的吞吐量……

entries.en: Surge now warns when the virtual network interface stops accepting packets, and tells you how to recover.
entries.zh: Surge 现在会在虚拟网络接口停止接收数据包时发出警告，并告知您如何恢复。

entries.en: Surge tvOS
entries.zh: Surge tvOS

entries.en: The Dashboard request details status is now a tinted capsule, matching Surge iOS.
entries.zh: 仪表盘请求详情状态现在显示为带颜色的胶囊状，与 Surge iOS 保持一致。

entries.en: The request list device filter now identifies LAN devices by MAC address.
entries.zh: 请求列表设备筛选器现在可通过 MAC 地址识别局域网设备。

entries.en: Update the UI style of the start button
entries.zh: 更新开始按钮的 UI 样式

entries.en: `$httpClient` responses now have `trailers`, so scripts calling gRPC endpoints can read `grpc-status`.
entries.zh: `$httpClient` 响应现在包含 `trailers`，因此调用 gRPC 端点的脚本可以读取 `grpc-status`。

entries.en: A `tuic` proxy with a UUID and no token is now treated as TUIC v5, matching other clients and subscription converters. Proxies with a token stay on v4.
entries.zh: 现在，带有 UUID 但没有令牌的 `tuic` 代理将被视为 TUIC v5，以与其他客户端和订阅转换器保持一致。带有令牌的代理仍保持在 v4。

entries.en: At the same time, the style of the online manual has also been updated to match the latest official website design.
entries.zh: 同时，在线手册的风格也已更新，以匹配最新的官方网站设计。

entries.en: Both request formats: a raw profile or JSON.
entries.zh: 两种请求格式：原始配置文件或 JSON。

entries.en: Faster uploads from local apps in Enhanced Mode.
entries.zh: 增强模式下，本地应用的上传速度更快。

entries.en: Fixed DNS queries over TCP from this device or a taken-over device to Surge's own Tailscale or WireGuard address being refused.
entries.zh: 修复了从此设备或被接管设备发出的、目标为 Surge 自身 Tailscale 或 WireGuard 地址的 DNS TCP 查询被拒绝的问题。

entries.en: Fixed editing a non-file Map Local rule turning it into a file rule and dropping its status code.
entries.zh: Fixed editing a non-file Map Local rule turning it into a file rule and dropping its status code.

entries.en: Fixed editing a rewrite rule dropping its comment and re-enabling a disabled rule; the comment marker is now kept.
entries.zh: 修复了编辑重写规则时其注释被删除以及重新启用已禁用规则的问题；现在注释标记将被保留。

entries.en: Fixed editing a rewrite rule dropping its comment, changing its comment marker, or re-enabling a disabled rule.
entries.zh: 修复了编辑重写规则时导致其注释丢失、注释标记被更改或已禁用规则被重新启用的问题。

entries.en: Fixed hybrid and Wi-Fi Assist filling the log with encrypted DNS errors when the DNS server was unreachable over cellular; Surge now skips that server over cellular for 30 seconds after a failure.
entries.zh: 修复了当 DNS 服务器在蜂窝网络下不可访问时，混合网络和 Wi-Fi 辅助功能会将加密 DNS 错误日志填满的问题；现在，在发生一次失败后，Surge 会在蜂窝网络下跳过该服务器 30 秒。

entries.en: Fixed light text on a light background in the Logbook script details in dark mode.
entries.zh: 修复了深色模式下日志簿脚本详情中浅色文本与浅色背景对比度不足的问题。

entries.en: Fixed some resolvers, such as those on Linux, Android and Go, treating Surge's empty DNS answers as a server failure.
entries.zh: 修复了部分解析器（例如 Linux、Android 和 Go 上的解析器）将 Surge 的空白 DNS 响应误判为服务器故障的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the DNS card and DNS results on the remote control dashboard not opening for the remote device.
entries.zh: 修复了远程设备控制面板上的 DNS 卡和 DNS 结果无法打开的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the MTProto proxy, HTTP API and port forwarding staying down after an automatic restart of Surge.
entries.zh: 修复了 Surge 自动重启后 MTProto 代理、HTTP API 和端口转发仍保持中断的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the UDP NAT type test hanging when a server rejected the HTTPUpgrade request.
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器拒绝 HTTPUpgrade 请求时 UDP NAT 类型测试卡住的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the end of a response sometimes being cut off when the server closed the connection.
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器关闭连接时，响应末尾有时会被截断的问题。

entries.en: HTTPUpgrade now works with sing-box and mihomo servers.
entries.zh: HTTPUpgrade now works with sing-box and mihomo servers.

entries.en: It covers:
entries.zh: 涵盖：

entries.en: Mock responses from `http-request` scripts now send `trailers` to HTTP/2 clients, so gRPC mocks can return a status.
entries.zh: 来自 `http-request` 脚本的模拟响应现在会向 HTTP/2 客户端发送 `trailers`，因此 gRPC 模拟可以返回一个状态。

entries.en: Modified requests are now shown in purple in the Dashboard.
entries.zh: 修改后的请求现在在仪表盘中以紫色显示。

entries.en: Modified requests are now shown in purple.
entries.zh: 修改后的请求现以紫色显示。

entries.en: New AI Integration page under Overview: one-click install of the Surge agent skill for Claude Code and Codex, a copyable install instruction for other agents, and the MCP server switch with ready-to-copy configurations for Claude Code, Codex, JSON or the key alone. The Help menu item opens it.
entries.zh: “概览”下新增 AI 集成页面：可一键安装适用于 Claude Code 和 Codex 的 Surge agent 技能，提供可供复制的其他智能体安装说明，以及 MCP 服务器切换功能，并附带可直接复制的适用于 Claude Code、Codex、JSON 或仅密钥的配置。点击“帮助”菜单项即可打开该页面。

entries.en: Profile Validation Service: Documentation Now Available
entries.zh: 配置文件验证服务：文档现已提供

entries.en: Rebuilt the URL Rewrite, Header Rewrite, Body Rewrite and Map Local editors as settings-card sheets. Reject URL rewrites and JSON JQ body rewrites can now be edited, and Map Local supports every data type and the status code.
entries.zh: 已将 URL Rewrite、Header Rewrite、Body Rewrite 和 Map Local 编辑器重构为 settings-card 工作表。现在可以编辑被拒绝的 URL rewrites 和 JSON JQ body rewrites，Map Local 也支持所有数据类型和状态码。

entries.en: Tailscale Split DNS routes are now honored, so domains with a restricted nameserver in the tailnet resolve through a Tailscale policy; the policy details list these routes.
entries.zh: Tailscale 拆分 DNS 路由现已生效，因此 tailnet 中使用了受限名称服务器的域名将通过 Tailscale 策略进行解析；策略详情会列出这些路由。

entries.en: Tailscale policies without an exit node, and WireGuard without DNS, no longer offer external IP, NAT type and bandwidth tests that cannot work, and the UDP relay test fails right away.
entries.zh: 不含出口节点的 Tailscale 策略组，以及不含 DNS 的 WireGuard，将不再提供无法运行的外部 IP、NAT 类型和带宽测试，而 UDP 中继测试会立即失败。

entries.en: Tailscale policy details now list Split DNS routes.
entries.zh: Tailscale 策略组详情现在会列出 Split DNS 路由。

entries.en: The DNS answer path is now drawn as a chain from the queried name through each CNAME to the addresses.
entries.zh: DNS 响应路径现在以链式方式绘制，从查询的名称开始，经过每个 CNAME，直至地址。

entries.en: The Rewrite page's cards have more room between them.
entries.zh: “Rewrite”页面上的卡片间距更大。

entries.en: The URL Rewrite, Header Rewrite, Body Rewrite and Map Local editors have a comment field. Rule and rewrite lists show comments on their own line, and search matches them.
entries.zh: URL Rewrite、Header Rewrite、Body Rewrite 和 Map Local 编辑器都包含一个注释字段。规则列表和重写列表会将注释显示在单独一行，并且搜索功能也能匹配这些注释。

entries.en: The iPerf loopback test host now always goes DIRECT, and its traffic is no longer counted in the traffic statistics.
entries.zh: iPerf 环回测试主机现在始终走 DIRECT 路径，其流量将不再计入流量统计。

entries.en: The new /v1/version endpoint, which shows the Surge version the parser is built from.
entries.zh: 新的 /v1/version 端点，用于显示解析器构建所用的 Surge 版本。

entries.en: The profile validation service (beta) at [https://services.nssurge.com](https://services.nssurge.com/) now has a page in the manual.
entries.zh: [https://services.nssurge.com](https://services.nssurge.com/) 上的配置文件验证服务（Beta 版）现在已在手册中新增一个页面。

entries.en: The remote page is split into Overview and Tools sections; the tools are a list as on the Utilities page, maintenance actions move into the More menu, and the last section shown is remembered.
entries.zh: 远程页面分为“概览”和“工具”两个部分；工具部分以列表形式呈现，与“实用程序”页面相同；维护操作移至“更多”菜单；最后显示的版块会被记住。

entries.en: The response format and status codes.
entries.zh: 响应格式和状态码。

entries.en: The rewrite editors have a comment field, and the rewrite lists have a Comment column.
entries.zh: 重写编辑器有一个注释字段，重写列表有一个“注释”列。

entries.en: The sidebar separator above Dashboard now uses the system separator style.
entries.zh: “仪表板”上方的侧边栏分隔线现在已使用系统分隔线样式。

entries.en: What the service does and doesn’t check. For example, it doesn’t resolve #!include files or download remote rule sets.
entries.zh: 该服务会检查哪些内容，不会检查哪些内容。例如，它不会解析 #!include 文件，也不会下载远程规则集。

entries.en: A faster request list. Every row has a site icon and its status in its own color, image responses show a thumbnail, and filters sit right above the list. Touch and hold a filter to invert it.
entries.zh: 更快的请求列表。每一行都带有网站图标，并以特定颜色显示其状态；图像响应会显示缩略图；筛选器则位于列表正上方。轻触并按住筛选器即可反转它。

entries.en: A new Home screen. Slide the first card to start Surge, then see live traffic, network health, usage, and quick controls on one dashboard. You choose which cards appear and in what order.
entries.zh: 全新的主屏幕。滑动第一张卡片即可启动 Surge，然后在一个仪表盘中查看实时流量、网络状态、使用情况以及快速控件。您可以选择要显示的卡片及其排列顺序。

entries.en: A stronger engine, shared with Surge Mac 6.12:
entries.zh: 与 Surge Mac 共用的更强大的引擎 6.12:

entries.en: An MCP server for AI agents. Turn on the MCP endpoint, and agents like Claude Code get the same control as surge-cli, even over Surge on another device. MCP apps on the iPhone itself, such as FlowDown and Minis, can drive Surge directly.
entries.zh: 一个用于 AI 智能体的 MCP 服务器。启用 MCP 端点后，Claude Code 等智能体将获得与 surge-cli 相同的控制权，甚至可以控制另一台设备上的 Surge。iPhone 设备本身上的 MCP 应用（例如 FlowDown 和 Minis）可以直接驱动 Surge。

entries.en: Beta Update - TLS Client Fingerprint
entries.zh: Beta 更新 - TLS 客户端指纹

entries.en: Dead policies are bypassed sooner: once a backup connection has taken over from a policy that could not connect, the site moves to the working policy instead of waiting for the dead one on every new connection.
entries.zh: 失效策略的绕过速度更快：一旦备用连接接管了无法连接的策略，站点就会切换到正常工作的策略，而不会在每次新连接时都等待失效策略。

entries.en: Designed for iOS 26. Configure sorts its settings into categories you can swipe between, policy group cards expand in place, and menus open right where you tap.
entries.zh: 专为 iOS 26 设计。Configure 将其设置按类别整理，您可以左右滑动切换；策略组卡片可原地展开，菜单则在您轻点的位置直接打开。

entries.en: Download on the App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id1442620678](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1442620678)
entries.zh: 在 App Store 下载：[https://apps.apple.com/app/id1442620678](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1442620678)

entries.en: Every engine change is tested automatically against the official client of each proxy protocol.
entries.zh: 每次引擎更改都会针对每种代理协议的官方客户端自动进行测试。

entries.en: Fixed `client-cert` being ignored by MASQUE over HTTP/3, Hysteria2 and TUIC, which made servers that require a client certificate reject the connection.
entries.zh: 修复了 MASQUE 在 HTTP/3、Hysteria2 和 TUIC 协议下忽略 `client-cert` 的问题，该问题曾导致需要客户端证书的服务端拒绝连接。

entries.en: Fixed a URL `#!include` file without a `FINAL` rule being rejected on its first download, although the including profile has one.
entries.zh: 修复了当某个 URL 的 `#!include` 文件在首次下载时被拒绝的问题，即使其包含的配置文件中存在一个 `FINAL` 规则。

entries.en: Fixed a working connection sometimes being closed after a leftover setup retry failed. This also broke DNS-over-TLS, Tailscale and HTTPS proxy tests that used an underlying proxy.
entries.zh: 修复了在某些情况下，当一次遗留的设置重试失败后，一个正常工作的连接有时会被关闭的问题。此问题也导致使用了底层代理的 DNS-over-TLS、Tailscale 和 HTTPS 代理测试中断。

entries.en: Fixed clicking the menu bar icon doing nothing while another app was in full screen and a Surge window was on another Space.
entries.zh: 修复了在另一款应用处于全屏模式且 Surge 窗口位于另一个“空间”时，点击菜单栏图标无响应的问题。

entries.en: Fixed hybrid sending encrypted DNS queries directly over cellular, bypassing the route chosen by the rules, when `encrypted-dns-follow-outbound-mode` is enabled.
entries.zh: 修复了在启用 `encrypted-dns-follow-outbound-mode` 时，混合发送加密 DNS 查询会直接通过蜂窝网络，从而绕过规则所选路由的问题。

entries.en: Fixed packet loss no longer counting in a smart group policy's score after a connection sent no packets.
entries.zh: 修复了连接未发送任何数据包后，数据包丢失在智能策略组的评分中不再被计入的问题。

entries.en: Fixed parameter values with leading or trailing spaces, such as `external-policy-name-prefix="[Hello] "`, losing those spaces when Surge rewrote the profile.
entries.zh: 修复了带有前导或尾随空格的参数值（例如 `external-policy-name-prefix="[Hello] "`）在 Surge 重写配置文件时丢失这些空格的问题。

entries.en: Fixed smart groups counting browser preconnections that never sent data as failures of a policy.
entries.zh: 修复了智能组将从未发送过数据的浏览器预连接计为策略组违规行为的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Face ID overlay flashing white over the launch screen in Dark Mode.
entries.zh: 修复了在深色模式下，Face ID 覆盖层在启动屏幕上闪烁为白色的问题。

entries.en: Full release notes: [https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6/release-notes](https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6/release-notes)
entries.zh: 完整发布说明：[https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6/release-notes](https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6/release-notes)

entries.en: It applies to HTTPS, SOCKS5-TLS, HTTP/2 CONNECT, Trust Tunnel, Trojan, AnyTLS, and VMess/VLESS with TLS or REALITY. The `fp` value of a share link is converted automatically. Since `auto` is the default, every TLS proxy now looks like Apple's system traffic out of the box; use `none` to keep the old behavior.
entries.zh: 此更新适用于 HTTPS、SOCKS5-TLS、HTTP/2 CONNECT、Trust Tunnel、Trojan、AnyTLS 以及使用 TLS 或 REALITY 的 VMess/VLESS。分享链接中的 `fp` 值会自动转换。由于 `auto` 是默认值，现在所有 TLS 代理开箱即用即可模拟 Apple 的系统流量；如需保留旧有行为，请使用 `none`。

entries.en: More accurate scoring: connections closed before the client sent anything, such as browser preconnections, no longer count as failures.
entries.zh: 评分更准确：在客户端发送任何内容之前就已关闭的连接（例如浏览器的预连接）不再计为失败。

entries.en: New `client-fingerprint` parameter makes TLS-over-TCP proxies (HTTPS, SOCKS5-TLS, HTTP/2, Trust Tunnel, Trojan, AnyTLS, and VMess and VLESS with TLS or REALITY) send the ClientHello of a real client: `apple-26` (Safari and apps on iOS and macOS 26), `chromium-155` (Chrome), `auto` (the default, currently `apple-26`) or `none` (the previous plain ClientHello). Without `alpn`, these connections now offer HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 like a browser. Share links map uTLS fingerprint names to these values.
entries.zh: 新增的 `client-fingerprint` 参数可让 TLS-over-TCP 代理（HTTPS、SOCKS5-TLS、HTTP/2、Trust Tunnel、Trojan、AnyTLS，以及使用 TLS 或 REALITY 的 VMess 和 VLESS）发送真实客户端的 ClientHello：`apple-26`（Safari 以及 iOS 和 macOS 26 上的应用）、`chromium-155`（Chrome）、`auto`（默认值，当前为 `apple-26`）或 `none`（之前的纯 ClientHello）。若未使用 `alpn`，这些连接现在会像浏览器一样支持 HTTP/2 和 HTTP/1.1。分享链接将 uTLS 指纹名称映射到这些值。

entries.en: New `ech-config` parameter enables Encrypted Client Hello for TLS- and QUIC-based proxies with the ECHConfigList you provide, so the real SNI is hidden. An unusable config fails the connection instead of falling back to a cleartext ClientHello, and when the server rejects ECH, the error includes the server's retry configs so you can update `ech-config`. ECH cannot be combined with REALITY.
entries.zh: 新增的 `ech-config` 参数可为基于 TLS 和 QUIC 的代理启用加密客户端问候（Encrypted Client Hello），并使用您提供的 ECHConfigList，从而隐藏真实的 SNI。如果配置文件不可用，连接将直接失败，而不会回退到明文客户端问候；当服务器拒绝 ECH 时，错误信息会包含服务器的重试配置，以便您更新 `ech-config`。ECH 无法与 REALITY 结合使用。

entries.en: No configuration changes are needed.
entries.zh: 无需进行任何配置更改。

entries.en: Plus a redesigned Remote Dashboard, a new News page, and many more improvements and fixes.
entries.zh: 此外，还重新设计了远程仪表板，新增了新闻页面，并进行了许多其他改进和修复。

entries.en: Profile History. Every save is a version: see what changed before you save, compare any two versions, and roll back in one tap. The text editor checks each line as you type.
entries.zh: 配置文件历史记录。每次保存都是一个版本：在保存前查看更改内容，比较任意两个版本，并通过一次轻触即可回滚。文本编辑器会在您输入时检查每一行。

entries.en: Proxies over TLS can now reproduce the TLS ClientHello of a real client, with the new `client-fingerprint` parameter:
entries.zh: 现在，Proxies over TLS 可以通过新的 `client-fingerprint` 参数，重现真实客户端的 TLS ClientHello：

entries.en: Proxy = trojan, example.com, 443, password=pwd, client-fingerprint=chromium-155
entries.zh: 代理 = 木马，example.com，443，password=pwd，client-fingerprint=chromium-155

entries.en: Rebuilt for iOS 26, Surge iOS 6 redraws nearly every screen in the app and runs the same engine as Surge Mac on your iPhone and iPad.
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 已针对 iOS 26 重构，重绘了应用中的几乎每个屏幕，并在您的 iPhone 和 iPad 上运行与 Surge Mac 相同的引擎。

entries.en: Slow transfers are noticed: besides latency, Surge now measures how long the first megabyte of a response takes. When a policy keeps delivering a site much more slowly than before, new connections to that site use another policy.
entries.zh: 现已注意到传输缓慢的问题：除了延迟之外，Surge 现在还会测量响应的第一个兆字节所需的时间。当某个策略组持续以比以前慢得多的速度传输某个网站的数据时，对该网站的新连接将改用另一个策略组。

entries.en: Smart Group improvements
entries.zh: 智能组改进

entries.en: Steadier exits: a site stays on the policy it is using unless another one is clearly faster, and connections opened to a new site at the same moment use the same policy.
entries.zh: 更稳定的出站连接：除非另一个策略组明显更快，否则站点将持续使用其当前使用的策略组；同时打开到新站点的连接将使用相同的策略组。

entries.en: Surge Mac 6.12 ships the same engine, so everything above under the engine applies on the Mac as well. Update from the app, or download it from [nssurge.com](http://nssurge.com/).
entries.zh: Surge Mac 6.12 采用了相同的引擎，因此上述有关引擎的所有内容也同样适用于 Mac 版本。请通过应用进行更新，或从 [nssurge.com](http://nssurge.com/) 下载。

entries.en: Surge Mac release notes: [https://nssurge.com/support/mac/release-notes](https://nssurge.com/support/mac/release-notes)
entries.zh: Surge Mac 版本说明：[https://nssurge.com/support/mac/release-notes](https://nssurge.com/support/mac/release-notes)

entries.en: Surge iOS 6 is a free update with a huge number of improvements to the interface and the core engine. Only a few new features need an active update subscription: the new Home screen, Profile History, and the MCP server.
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 是一款免费更新，对界面和核心引擎进行了大量改进。只有少数新功能需要有效的更新订阅：新的主屏幕、配置文件历史记录以及 MCP 服务器。

entries.en: Surge iOS 6 is now available on the App Store, alongside Surge Mac 6.12 and Surge tvOS 6.0.
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 现已在 App Store 上架，同时发布的还有 Surge Mac 6.12 和 Surge tvOS 6.0。

entries.en: Surge tvOS 6.0 brings the new engine to Apple TV, with a redesigned start screen showing live activity, recent events, and Surge Ponte status, plus quick access to the outbound mode, policy groups, and external resources. The profile and log viewers are rebuilt too. After updating, set up your Apple TV again from Surge iOS 6.
entries.zh: Surge tvOS 6.0 将全新引擎引入 Apple TV，其重新设计的启动屏幕可显示实时活动、近期事件和 Surge Ponte 状态，并快速访问出站模式、策略组和外部资源。配置文件和日志查看器也已重构。更新后，请再次通过 Surge iOS 6 设置您的 Apple TV。

entries.en: Surge's TLS is built on BoringSSL, the same library Chrome uses, and Apple's TLS stack runs on its own fork of it. The fingerprints therefore come from the library itself rather than from a template: GREASE values, extension order and ECH GREASE are generated the same way as in the original clients, and the rest of the handshake follows the same code.
entries.zh: Surge 的 TLS 基于 BoringSSL 构建，而 Chrome 也使用相同的库；Apple 的 TLS 栈则运行在其自行分叉的版本之上。因此，这些指纹信息源自该库本身，而非来自某个模板：GREASE 值、扩展顺序以及 ECH GREASE 的生成方式与原始客户端相同，而握手过程的其余部分也遵循相同的代码。

entries.en: TLS
entries.zh: TLS

entries.en: The proxy editor has new Client Fingerprint and ECH Configuration options.
entries.zh: 代理编辑器新增了客户端指纹和 ECH 配置选项。

entries.en: Two panes when there's room. On wider screens, the dashboard stays next to your settings.
entries.zh: 空间允许时，显示两个窗格。在更宽的屏幕上，仪表板会保持在设置旁边。

entries.en: What's new:
entries.zh: 新增内容：

entries.en: `apple-26`: Apple's system TLS stack, as sent by Safari and by apps using NSURLSession: iOS 26–27, macOS 26–27, Safari 26–27
entries.zh: `apple-26`: Apple 的系统 TLS 堆栈，由 Safari 及使用 NSURLSession 的应用程序发送：iOS 26–27、macOS 26–27、Safari 26–27

entries.en: `auto` (default): The recommended fingerprint, currently `apple-26`
entries.zh: `auto`（默认）：推荐指纹，当前为 `apple-26`

entries.en: `chromium-155`: Chrome 155–158 and the browsers built on Chromium
entries.zh: `chromium-155`: Chrome 155–158 以及基于 Chromium 构建的浏览器

entries.en: – A server that stops answering is replaced within seconds
entries.zh: – 停止响应的服务器会在数秒内被替换

entries.en: – Accept incoming WireGuard peers
entries.zh: – 接受传入的 WireGuard 对等体

entries.en: – Adaptive QUIC blocking that keeps QUIC-only apps working
entries.zh: – 自适应 QUIC 拦截，确保仅使用 QUIC 的应用仍可正常运行

entries.en: – Bring your own certificates for MITM
entries.zh: – 使用您自己的证书进行 MITM

entries.en: – More proxy protocols and transports, plus share-link import for every supported protocol
entries.zh: – 支持更多代理协议和传输方式，并为每种受支持的协议添加分享链接导入功能

entries.en: – Much less memory with large profiles and thousands of proxies
entries.zh: – 大型配置文件和数千个代理的内存占用大幅减少

entries.en: – Offer your device to your tailnet as a Tailscale exit node or subnet router
entries.zh: – 将您的设备提供给您的 tailnet，用作 Tailscale 出口节点或子网路由器

entries.en: Because the TCP buffers of these connections now live in Surge's own process rather than in the kernel, Activity Monitor attributes that memory to Surge. Surge's memory usage may therefore appear higher than before, but the system's total memory usage has not changed; the same memory is simply counted under Surge instead of the kernel.
entries.zh: 由于这些连接的 TCP 缓冲区现在位于 Surge 自己的进程中，而非内核中，因此“活动监视器”会将这部分内存归因于 Surge。因此，Surge 的内存使用情况可能看起来比以前更高，但系统的总内存使用情况并未改变；只是相同的内存现在计入了 Surge，而非内核。

entries.en: Create Linked Profile now starts from a copy of the whole profile, is available on every profile row and links to the manual.
entries.zh: “创建链接配置文件”现在从整个配置文件的副本开始，适用于每个配置文件行，并链接到手册。

entries.en: Editing a managed or Team profile, in an editor or with a quick action, offers to convert it into a linked profile in place, and the editor keeps saving to the converted profile.
entries.zh: 在编辑器中或通过快速操作编辑受管理或团队配置文件时，系统会提供就地将其转换为链接配置文件的选项，且编辑器会继续将更改保存至该已转换的配置文件中。

entries.en: Fixed MITM HTTP/2 requests to a host waiting forever with "Wait previous connection setup completed" after a server accepted a connection but never answered the TLS handshake; the setup now times out.
entries.zh: 修复了 MITM HTTP/2 请求在服务器接受连接但从未响应 TLS 握手后，因等待“等待先前的连接建立完成”而无限期挂起的问题；现在该建立过程会超时。

entries.en: Fixed `$httpClient` sending a TypedArray request body as JSON instead of bytes on JavaScriptCore.
entries.zh: 修复了 `$httpClient` 在 JavaScriptCore 上将 TypedArray 请求体作为 JSON 而非字节发送的问题。

entries.en: Fixed `console.log` printing arrays and errors poorly.
entries.zh: 修复了 `console.log` 对数组和错误的打印效果不佳的问题。

entries.en: Fixed `setTimeout` without a delay or with extra arguments.
entries.zh: 修复了 `setTimeout` 在没有延迟或带有额外参数的情况下出现的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a runaway script on the WebView engine leaving later scripts stuck; timed-out scripts are now fully stopped.
entries.zh: 修复了 WebView 引擎上一个失控脚本导致后续脚本卡住的问题；现在超时的脚本会被完全停止。

entries.en: Fixed connections that closed normally being listed as failed with "Reset by client" or "Reset by remote" since 6.12.0.
entries.zh: 修复了自 6.12.0 以来，正常关闭的连接被错误地标记为失败，并显示“由客户端重置”或“由远程方重置”的问题。

entries.en: Fixed exceptions in WebView scripts, including syntax errors and exceptions in timer and `$httpClient` callbacks, not stopping the script as on JavaScriptCore; the reported line numbers now refer to your script.
entries.zh: 修复了 WebView 脚本中的异常，包括语法错误以及定时器回调和 `$httpClient` 回调中的异常，脚本不会像 JavaScriptCore 那样停止；现在报告的行号对应于您的脚本。

entries.en: Fixed installing a profile from a URL failing with a parse error when the profile uses `#!include`.
entries.zh: 修复了当配置文件使用 `#!include` 时，从 URL 安装配置文件会因解析错误而失败的问题。

entries.en: Fixed license activation timing out on some networks.
entries.zh: 修复了在部分网络上许可证激活超时的错误。

entries.en: Fixed the Sapphire logo appearing oversized on the Home tab.
entries.zh: 修复了“主页”选项卡中蓝宝石徽标显示过大的问题。

entries.en: Fixed updates failing to install with a timeout, for example while a macOS update was pending.
entries.zh: 修复了更新因超时而安装失败的问题，例如在 macOS 更新待处理时发生的情况。

entries.en: Linked Profiles work as on Mac: installing a managed profile from a URL asks which sections stay synchronized (Rule, Proxy and Proxy Group by default) and copies the rest into an editable profile, with Fully Managed Mode as the alternative.
entries.zh: 关联配置文件的功能与 Mac 版一致：通过 URL 安装受管理配置文件时，系统会询问保留哪些部分保持同步（默认保留规则集、代理和策略组），并将其余部分复制到可编辑的配置文件中，此外还提供完全受管理模式作为替代选项。

entries.en: Logbook rows now look like the request list, with a colored status dot, neutral script-type badges and the record's details. An empty list or a search without results shows the system's empty state.
entries.zh: 日志簿行现在看起来与请求列表类似，带有彩色状态点、中性脚本样式的徽章以及记录详情。空列表或无结果的搜索将显示系统的空状态。

entries.en: On macOS 15 or later, outgoing TCP connections, both DIRECT and to proxy servers, now use Network.framework, Apple's modern user-space networking stack, instead of BSD sockets. Data waiting to be relayed no longer sits in the kernel's shared network buffers, so heavy multi-connection traffic, such as a speed test from a device using Surge as its gateway, can no longer exhaust them and cause macOS to forcibly stop Surge.
entries.zh: 在 macOS 15 或更高版本上，无论是 DIRECT 连接还是连接到代理服务器的出站 TCP 连接，现在都使用 Apple 现代化的用户空间网络栈 Network.framework，而非 BSD 套接字。等待转发的数据不再驻留在内核的共享网络缓冲区中，因此，使用 Surge 作为网关的设备执行速度测试等高流量多连接操作，将不再耗尽这些缓冲区，也不会导致 macOS 强制停止 Surge。

entries.en: Quick actions that would change a read-only section of a linked profile are now refused instead of being dropped silently on save.
entries.zh: Quick actions that would change a read-only section of a linked profile are now refused instead of being dropped silently on save.

entries.en: The ECN option in the proxy editor is now an Auto / On / Off choice and is available for TCP proxies on macOS 15 and later. Fixed Auto showing as on and any click writing an explicit `ecn`.
entries.zh: 代理编辑器中的 ECN 选项现在可选“自动/开/关”，且适用于 macOS 15 及更高版本上的 TCP 代理。修复了“自动”状态错误显示为“开”的问题，以及任何点击操作都会写入显式的 `ecn` 的问题。

entries.en: The ECN option in the proxy editor is now an Auto / On / Off menu and is available for TCP proxies on iOS 18 and later. Fixed Auto showing as on and any change writing an explicit `ecn`.
entries.zh: 代理编辑器中的 ECN 选项现在是一个“自动/开/关”菜单，适用于 iOS 18 及更高版本上的 TCP 代理。修复了“自动”选项显示为“开”的问题，以及任何更改都会写入一个显式的 `ecn` 的问题。

entries.en: The `ecn` parameter now also applies to TCP proxies on macOS 15 and later and iOS 18 and later: `ecn=true` or `ecn=false` turns ECN on or off for the connection to the server, and Auto leaves it to the system.
entries.zh: `ecn` 参数现在也适用于 macOS 15 及更高版本和 iOS 18 及更高版本上的 TCP 代理：`ecn=true` 或 `ecn=false` 可开启或关闭与服务器的连接上的 ECN，而“自动”选项则交由系统决定。

entries.en: The policy group member picker now uses the inset grouped style.
entries.zh: 策略组成员选择器现在使用内嵌分组样式。

entries.en: User-space TCP networking stack
entries.zh: 用户空间 TCP 网络协议栈

entries.en: WebView scripts now stop when more than 64 timers are pending, as on JavaScriptCore.
entries.zh: WebView 脚本现在会在有超过 64 个计时器挂起时停止执行，与 JavaScriptCore 的行为一致。

entries.en: WebView scripts that handle large `$httpClient` bodies, `$persistentStore` data or `$utils.ungzip` use much less memory.
entries.zh: 处理大型 `$httpClient` 主体、`$persistentStore` 数据或 `$utils.ungzip` 的 WebView 脚本现在占用的内存要少得多。

entries.en: `$persistentStore` now stores non-string values as JSON on both script engines.
entries.zh: `$persistentStore` 现在会在两种脚本引擎上将非字符串值存储为 JSON。

entries.en: Fixed a crash when opening the proxy editor.
entries.zh: 修复了打开代理编辑器时发生的崩溃问题。

entries.en: Fixed black notches on the policy group cards below an expanded card in the card style.
entries.zh: 修复了卡片样式中，展开卡片下方的策略组卡片上出现的黑色缺口。

entries.en: Fixed requests to a Tailscale or WireGuard peer on a port that refuses connections waiting out the setup timeout (20 seconds for Tailscale) and then failing with 503. They now fail right away with "Connection refused". With `prefer-ipv6`, this affected every request to a peer service that listens only on IPv4.
entries.zh: 修复了向 Tailscale 或 WireGuard 对等体发起的、目标端口拒绝连接的请求，在等待设置超时（Tailscale 为 20 秒）后以 503 错误失败的问题。现在这些请求会立即以“连接被拒绝”失败。在 `prefer-ipv6` 配置下，这会影响所有向仅监听 IPv4 的对等体服务发起的请求。

entries.en: New `include-children` option for PROCESS-NAME rules, also available in the rule editor: the rule also matches requests made on an app's behalf, such as child processes the app launches (even from executables outside its bundle) and system services working for it, such as WebKit Networking. Shared system daemons such as nsurlsessiond are not attributed to an app.
entries.zh: 为 PROCESS-NAME 规则新增 `include-children` 选项，该选项也可在规则编辑器中使用：此规则还会匹配以应用名义发起的请求，例如应用启动的子进程（即使这些子进程来自其应用包之外的可执行文件）以及为其工作的系统服务（例如 WebKit Networking）。像 nsurlsessiond 这样的共享系统守护进程则不会归属到某个应用。

entries.en: Outgoing TCP connections use BSD sockets again instead of Network.framework, which limited each connection's receive buffer to about 7 MB and could halve single-connection download speed on high-latency paths. Heavy multi-connection traffic still can't exhaust the kernel's network buffers: when a client reads more slowly than the server sends, Surge now limits how much data waits in the kernel. Activity Monitor no longer counts that TCP buffer memory under Surge.
entries.zh: 出站 TCP 连接现在重新使用 BSD sockets，而非 Network.framework。后者会将每个连接的接收缓冲区限制在约 7 MB，可能导致高延迟路径下的单连接下载速度减半。即使是大流量的多连接通信，仍无法耗尽内核的网络缓冲区：当客户端的读取速度慢于服务器的发送速度时，Surge 现在会限制在内核中等待的数据量。活动监视器不再将这部分 TCP 缓冲区内存计入 Surge。

entries.en: Tailscale now warns when a DNS server, such as `dns-server`, a resolver from the tailnet or a Split DNS nameserver, cannot be reached through any peer, subnet route or selected exit node. Previously, queries to such a server only timed out after 5 seconds. The warning names the unreachable servers and goes away once they become reachable.
entries.zh: 现在，当无法通过任何对等节点、子网路由或选定的出口节点访问 DNS 服务器（例如 `dns-server`、来自 tailnet 的解析器或 Split DNS 名称服务器）时，Tailscale 会发出警告。此前，对此类服务器的查询只有在 5 秒后才会超时。该警告会列出无法访问的服务器名称，并在这些服务器恢复可访问后消失。

entries.en: Fixed Personal Hotspot Access not noticing the hotspot turning on or off until another network change.
entries.zh: 修复了“个人热点访问”在发生其他网络更改前无法检测到热点开启或关闭的问题。

entries.en: Fixed Wi-Fi Access (LAN proxy, external controller and HTTP API) staying on an old address until it was toggled, after the Wi-Fi address changed, such as with a new DHCP lease on the same network or when Wi-Fi is not the primary interface.
entries.zh: 修复了 Wi-Fi 地址变更后（例如在同一网络上获得新的 DHCP 租约，或 Wi-Fi 非主要网络接口时），Wi-Fi 访问（LAN 代理、外部控制器和 HTTP API）仍停留在旧地址，直到被切换的问题。

entries.en: Fixed `script-update-interval=-1` (Disable in the iOS script editor) no longer stopping remote script updates.
entries.zh: 修复了 `script-update-interval=-1`（在 iOS 脚本编辑器中禁用）不再阻止远程脚本更新的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a policy group icon sometimes being replaced by an oversized remote image on first load.
entries.zh: 修复了首次加载时策略组图标有时会被超大远程图片覆盖的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a vertical scroll on the Profile and Modules pages sometimes being taken as a category swipe, so the list did not scroll until the finger was lifted.
entries.zh: 修复了“配置文件”和“模块”页面上的垂直滚动有时会被误判为类别滑动的问题，导致列表在手指抬起前无法滚动。

entries.en: Fixed hiding the Network card on the start tab also removing the outbound mode control from the remote control page for another device, such as an Apple TV. The card arrangement now applies only to this device's start tab.
entries.zh: 修复了在“开始”选项卡中隐藏“网络”卡片的问题，并从另一台设备（如 Apple TV）的远程控制页面中移除了“出站”模式控件。现在，卡片布局仅适用于本设备的“开始”选项卡。

entries.en: Fixed picking an encoding in the text viewer not closing the picker or updating its check mark.
entries.zh: 修复了在文本查看器中选择编码时，选择器未关闭或其复选标记未更新的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the last lines of the full-screen field editor being hidden under the keyboard. It now also keeps the field's smart quote, dash and spell-checking settings.
entries.zh: 修复了全屏字段编辑器最后几行被键盘隐藏的问题。现在它还会保留字段的智能引号、短横线以及拼写检查设置。

entries.en: Fixed uploaded logs often missing the diagnostic report, or including a stale one from an earlier upload.
entries.zh: 修复了上传的日志经常缺少诊断报告，或包含来自先前上传的陈旧报告的问题。

entries.en: Opening a saved capture session is now instant: the newest 300 requests show right away and the rest load in the background, instead of a large session freezing the app for seconds. Album mode and export become available once the whole session has loaded.
entries.zh: 现在打开已保存的捕获会话已是即时操作：最新的 300 个请求会立即显示，其余请求则在后台加载，而不会因大型会话导致应用冻结数秒。待整个会话加载完成后，相册模式和导出功能即可使用。

entries.en: Ruleset entries in inline and local file rulesets now have an editable comment, and the ruleset content table has a Comment column.
entries.zh: 内联和本地文件规则集中的规则集条目现在都带有可编辑的注释，并且规则集内容表中新增了一列“注释”。

entries.en: Ruleset entries in inline and local file rulesets now have an editable comment.
entries.zh: 内联和本地文件规则集中的规则集条目现在可以添加可编辑的注释。

entries.en: The regex fields of the Map Local, URL, Header and Body Rewrite editors now use a keyboard with a space bar, and Body Rewrite's regex and replacement fields accept text in any language.
entries.zh: Map Local、URL、Header 和 Body Rewrite 编辑器的正则表达式字段现在使用带空格键的键盘，并且 Body Rewrite 的正则表达式和替换字段可接受任何语言的文本。

entries.en: When the VPN stops, the logbook and the stop notification now name the reason. When another VPN takes over, the logbook and notification now say so in all cases, not only some.
entries.zh: 当 VPN 停止时，日志簿和停止通知现在会说明原因。当另一个 VPN 接管时，日志簿和通知现在会在所有情况下（而不仅仅是部分情况下）说明这一点。

entries.en: [Map Local] rules whose data is a remote file now support `update-interval`, like RULE-SET: 0 keeps the 24-hour default and a negative value disables automatic updates. Previously the file always refreshed every 24 hours and the option was dropped when the rule was saved. Both editors offer the interval for remote files.
entries.zh: [Map Local] 规则中，若其数据为远程文件，则现在支持 `update-interval`，例如 RULE-SET: 0 可保留 24 小时默认值，而负值则会禁用自动更新。此前，文件会每 24 小时强制刷新一次，且保存规则时会丢弃该选项。现在，两个编辑器都为远程文件提供了间隔时间设置。
